# CRM Integration Specialists

> CRM Integration Specialists, led by Ammar Hussain, engineers custom bi-directional API bridges between GoHighLevel, Clio Manage, Lawmatics, Filevine, and Retell AI voice agents for law firms and legal agencies.

Every integration is built on real-time, webhook-driven sync with sub-380ms latency, 100% field-mapping accuracy, SHA-256 deduplication logic, and dead-letter retry queues built into dedicated middleware (n8n & Node.js).

## Core Services

- [GoHighLevel to Clio Integration](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/ghl-clio-integration): Real-time, two-way data sync between GoHighLevel and Clio Manage for legal practices.
- [n8n Webhook Middleware Development](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/n8n-webhook-middleware): Dedicated middleware with dead-letter retry queues, HMAC verification, and zero silent failures.
- [Retell AI Voice CRM Integration](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/retell-ai-crm-integration): Retell AI voice agents wired directly into legal CRMs for live call logging, real-time function calling, and post-call intake updates.
- [Legal Practice Workflow Automation](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/legal-automation-n8n): End-to-end legal pipelines connecting intake forms, e-sign retainers, Clio matters, and billing.
